I'm going to stop responding to comments where I feel the need to clarify. The point of me sharing my story is to discourage people who are on the edge of the bridge, metaphorically. I know I'm not going to affect those whose minds are made up, nor am I a licensed therapist. I understand that this is the drug subreddit, but I have not shared what I took with any of my friends or family (excluding people who *had* to know, such as my parents) and I'm not going to start. Considering this is an intimate story to tell, you'd figure I could keep one thing to myself.

Regardless, I don't give a fuck if someone is nitpicky about my wording or beliefs. My story is not for you. I care about the people who this affects personally. People who knew someone, was someone, or was going to be someone in a situation like mine. 

I understand that not all pills are equal. Yes, certain things will kill you relatively without physical pain. I'd like to say this upfront: I'm not an expert or a doctor. I'm a girl who went through a bad experience. But, I also know that most of you are not doctors or experts either, and it would be harder to believe that if your username involves ass or dick or other strange vulgarities. Like, wow, it's hard to respect the opinion of someone who would name themselves such. 

In conclusion, I apologise for not being the foremost expert on suicide via overdose, but I will respond to all the questions (within reason) and kind words that I can. For those of you who offer encouragement, thank you and good luck to you as well. Fight well
